title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? 3541 views Q. Nikah 1979 views Q. In one fatwa,a person asked from u:Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? U replied :A man and woman, before nikah, are like strangers; they can not see and meet each other. It is not right to see the girl you want to marry by appointing a meeting; it is allowable only if you see her by chance. It is better to get a proposed girl seen by ones relative women. In another fatwa a person asked:Assalamalaikum I have come to know that it is not permissible to even look at 'ghair-mahram', i.e., someone who you are eligible to marry with. If this is true, then how can a person - male or female - decide his/her future spouse? U replied:It is prohibited to look at ghar-mahram, (strange opposite sex) but if you intend to marry a girl then you can see her once, rather it has been declared allowed in a hadith. Please clarify this can we see a girl which we intend to marry.After seeing her if we doesn't like to marry her so it will be ok to regect and see another girl? 13189 views Q. Is it ok for a girl whose both parents are syed to marry a guy who isnt a syed when everything else is ok or should the parents wait to see if they find a syed boy? 3343 views Q. main aap hazraat is umeed se yeh sawal kar raha hoon ki aap mujhe sahi rah batayenge aur ISHA-ALLAH aap mere yaqeen to qayam rakhenge. SAWAL YE HAI KI, main apni ek muslim friend ko bahut chahta hoon aur woh bhi mujhe bahut chahti hai lekin hum dono ki cast alag hai jiski wajah se mujhe nahi lagta hai ki hum dono ki marriage ho payegi jabki hum dono ek doosre se marriage karna chahte hai. uski ammi bahut conservative hai jabki mere ghar mein koi problem nahi hai. jab maine apne ek muslim dost ko apni pareshani batai to unhone mujhe dua-tabeez ki help lene ko kaha ki INSHA-ALLAH ise problem solve ho jayegi aur uske ghar wale maan jayenge. jab maine yeh kaha ki yeh galat hai to unhone kaha ki yeh galat nahi hai kyunki isse hum kisi ka bura nahi chah rahe hai. Ab main is confussion mein hoon ki main kya karoon. plz aap mujhe sahi raak dikhayen. NABI KAREEM (PBUH) ka irshad hai jiska makhfoom khulaasa hai "amal ka daromadar niyat par hai" aur meri niyat sahi bhi hai main usse marriage karna chahta hoon aur islam mein cast-system ki bhi koi jagah nahi hai, to kya yeh dua-tabee ka tareeqa sahi hai. kyunki hum dono ek doosre ko bahut chahte hai lekin ghar walo ki izazat ke baghair marriage bhi nahi karna chahte. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 147738 Country: India Title: Is it mustahab, mustaqil sunnah or sunnat-e-Ghair Muwakkidah to perform nikah in the mosque? Question: Is it mustahab, mustaqil sunnah or sunnat-e-Ghair Muwakkidah to perform nikah in the mosque? Answer ID: 147738 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 621/643/L=6/1438) It is mustahab to do nikah in the mosque. مباشرة عقدالنكاح فى المساجد مستحب . (الهندية : 5/321) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
